Key to read from the machine custom data
config.recipe.condition.nbt_compare.valu: Value the custom data entry is compared against
config.recipe.condition.block.tags.toolt: Block tags to match; the block condition passes when any tag matches
config.recipe.condition.show_in_gui.tool: Whether this condition is listed in the recipe GUI condition description
config.definition.trait.ars_source_stora: Maximum amount of source this machine can store.
Maximum amount of source moved per transfer.
IN: only receive source. OUT: only output source (rituals can take, and it pushes to nearby targets). BOTH: like a source jar, accepts and can be drained, no active push.
config.definition.trait.overstack_item_s: Allows stackable items to exceed their normal max stack size according to the selected overstack mode.
EXACT: the value is the slot limit for 64-stack items; other items use floor(x * value / 64). MULTIPLIER: each item's limit is floor(x * value).
EXACT uses the value as the 64-stack limit and scales other items proportionally. MULTIPLIER uses the value as a direct multiplier.
